anya: quick flag  the "Error Ref: Retry Signals" PR is failing snippet CI because the example outputs vary across SDK versions. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/678

kevin: can you point to the failing snippet?

anya: the cross-language 'detect-retry-signal' example. CI shows either `429 Too Many Requests` or `StreamEOF` depending on server behaviour; golden asserts fail. Link: https://ci.redwood/infr/snippets/678

zheng: runtime note  when memory pressure hits we sometimes close the connection instead of returning a 429. Docs should teach readers to treat both as transient and to prefer Retry-After when present.

kevin: suggest we change examples to call a tiny helper `detectRetrySignal(err, headers)` and then include a small micro-eval with three deterministic cases (429+Retry-After, stream-eof, success). That should stabilize goldens.

anya: yes. also we need a clear single-sentence rule for the top of the page: "Treat HTTP 429, explicit Retry-After, and stream truncation as transient signals; prefer Retry-After when present."

zheng: I'll paste language-agnostic pseudo helper we can canonicalize:
```
function detectRetrySignal(err, headers) {
  if (headers?.['retry-after']) return {shouldRetry: true, reason: 'retry-after'}
  if (err?.status === 429) return {shouldRetry: true, reason: '429'}
  if (err?.code === 'STREAM_EOF' || headers?.['x-rw-evict']) return {shouldRetry: true, reason: 'stream-or-evict'}
  return {shouldRetry: false}
}
```
kevin: perfect. in the docs we'll avoid printing the internal header name and instead say "the server may signal eviction via headers". good call.

docs-bot: snippet-lint: prior run shows 2 mismatches. Recommendation: include explicit expected lines in micro-eval and keep the harness seeds fixed.

anya: kevin, can you add the micro-eval YAML and update the JS/Python examples to call the helper? keep each snippet under 20 lines so readers can skim.

kevin: on it. I'll also add a short note about idempotency: "Do not auto-retry non-idempotent writes unless an idempotency key is present; instead surface retry suggestions to the caller."

snippets-bot: holding snippet publish until PR updated and micro-eval passes.

anya: thanks all 64f I'll review the changes after your push. Once CI green I'll update the runbook link to point to the consolidated error-ref section.

zheng: ping me if you want language variants included; I'll add small Python + Go helpers after the JS sample lands.
